name: Anaheim GardenWalk (Near Disneyland) P.F. Chang's Steamed Chicken/Shrimp Dumplings, Wonton Soup & White Rice
brandOrRestaurant: P.F. Chang's & Cheesecake Factory (Anaheim GardenWalk · 1 Block East of Disneyland)
whyItWorks: One block from Disneyland at Anaheim GardenWalk, P.F. Chang's prepares Steamed Shrimp/Pork Dumplings, Wonton Soup, and Gluten-Free/Mild Ginger Chicken or Salmon with steamed white rice (and Cheesecake Factory next door has a huge SkinnyLicious Grilled Salmon/Chicken & White Rice menu).
prepOrOrderInstructions: At P.F. Chang's, ask for Steamed Dumplings (no chili sauce), Wonton Soup, or Grilled/Steamed Chicken Breast & White Rice with sauce on the side.
watchOuts: Skip Chang's Spicy Chicken, Orange Peel Chicken (citrus!), and crispy green beans
